title: Croissant Sliverfish
description: Replaces the Silverfish with adorable croissant-themed textures and models, adding a humorous and bakery-inspired twist to your game.
body:
🥐Croissant Silverfish
-
It is a creative Minecraft resource pack that transforms the usual creepy silverfish into playful croissant-shaped creatures.  
Instead of the default insect-like appearance, players will encounter flaky, golden pastry-inspired mobs that bring a lighthearted and comedic feel to underground exploration.   
This pack is perfect for players who enjoy food-themed aesthetics, meme-style texture packs, or simply want to make their Minecraft world a little more delicious and less terrifying.

<details>
<summary>Ahhhhh I admitted it</summary>

This little quirky, strangely unsettling texture creation of mine isn’t actually some carefully planned piece of work at all. In all honesty, it is merely one of those weird, unintentionally eerie, cursed-looking accidental side outputs, the kind of unintended leftover derivative result that came straight from my previously released texture pack project known as [CuteBlockySilverfish](https://modrinth.com/project/bFOqsU0k). That is to say, if you take a close look at its odd, misshapen visual form, you can clearly tell it bears a striking, almost unsettling resemblance to wriggling maggots, which is exactly why this strangely cursed, maggot-resembling little mob texture was unused in that pack. But I suppose that someone would like it so released it individually.

</details>

🔧Compatibility
-
Compatible with Minecraft Java Edition 1.6 and newer.    
Textures and Model of Silverfish Spawn Egg only available in 1.13 and newer in Vanilla.
